states.regulator_name: Alaska Real Estate Commission, Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
allowed_delivery_methods: Virtual course (student present on a device with video and audio)
states.ARELLO_status: Not referenced in 12 AAC 64 Article 7 as read on 2026-08-19. Certification is by the commission or its designee.
states.reporting_requirements: No periodic completion report to the commission is prescribed in 12 AAC 64 Article 7 as read on 2026-08-19. What the rules do require of a sponsor is the certificate of completion under 12 AAC 64.410(a)(9), production of records on audit under 12 AAC 64.470(c), and reporting a change in course content or materials made under 12 AAC 64.420(e) within 15 days after receipt of the public memorandum or press release the change is based on. Any substantive change other than one described in 12 AAC 64.420(e) is filed as an amendment to the approved outline on the 45-day schedule in 12 AAC 64.420(b). Whether the commission expects a separate roster is an open question to put to staff before the first course is offered; it is not assumed here.
states.record_retention_period: No retention period for education-provider student records is stated in 12 AAC 64 Article 7 as read on 2026-08-19. AS 08.88.351 imposes three-year retention on brokers' transaction records, which is a different obligation and is not read across. StateCourse retains Alaska student completion records permanently as a provider standard, because 12 AAC 64.470(c) permits the commission to audit a certified course at any time and a record that has been aged out cannot answer an audit.
states.enrollment_period: Education used to qualify for initial licensure must have been completed within the 18 months immediately preceding the date of application - 12 AAC 64.063(a)(2) - or within 24 months where initial licensure is by endorsement. Course certification itself runs from the date the commission certifies the course until January 31 of the next even-numbered year, except that a course certified from October 15 of an odd-numbered year through January 31 of an even-numbered year runs until January 31 of the following even-numbered year (12 AAC 64.420(c)). The commission provides recertification applications by October 15 of odd-numbered years.
states.final_exam_rules: A correspondence course must include an unanswered examination, or a project activity, turned in to the INSTRUCTOR for grading on completion; the instrument is submitted to the commission for prior approval (12 AAC 64.430(b)). Automatic server-side scoring alone does not meet this.
states.proctoring_rules: Not prescribed for correspondence courses in 12 AAC 64 Article 7 as read. A virtual course instead requires the student to be present on a device with video and audio and to meet a strict attendance policy (12 AAC 64.410(a)(6)-(7)).
states.certificate_rules: The certificate of completion must show the student name, the city where the course was held, the course title AND course approval number, the delivery date, the contact hours awarded, the signature of the instructor or sponsor, and the instructor's name (12 AAC 64.410(a)(9)). It issues only after the student completes a course and instructor evaluation.
states.notes: 40 hours of commission-approved prelicensing education. Course certification applications must be submitted 45 days before the first course; a course is approved if the commission or its designee does not disapprove within 45 days of a complete application. Instructors are separately approved and must have adult teaching or training experience plus a qualifying degree or five years of licensed practice in the topic area (12 AAC 64.440). Read in the Alaska Real Estate Commission Statutes and Regulations (September 2024) and the Initial Course Application Instructions on 2026-08-19. A correspondence course additionally requires the complete course materials and the lesson instructions to be submitted (12 AAC 64.430(a)) and an unanswered examination or project activity turned in to the instructor for grading, filed with the commission for prior approval (12 AAC 64.430(b)). The commission may audit a certified course at any time (12 AAC 64.470(c)). Article 7 read in full on 2026-08-19.
states.daily_credit_limit: 12 AAC 64.410(c) caps credit at 10 hours of instruction per day for the continuing education requirements of AS 08.88.091 and 12 AAC 64.500, and 8 hours per day for the education requirements of AS 08.88.095 and 12 AAC 64.064. Neither paragraph names the AS 08.88.091(b) 40-hour prelicense requirement, so the rule as written does not appear to cap prelicense hours per day. StateCourse applies the 8-hour figure to the prelicense course anyway as a provider standard and will confirm the point with commission staff rather than rely on the silence. No StateCourse document may describe the 8-hour figure as an Alaska prelicense requirement.

states.regulator_name: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs, Bureau of Professional Licensing
states.ARELLO_status: Optional. A distance course either supplies proof of ARELLO certification or documents the five elements required by Rule 626(2)(b)-(f): modules of instruction, a learning objective for each module, a structured learning method for each objective, assessment of performance during each module, and remediation repeating the module until the student understands it.
states.reporting_requirements: Names of students who successfully completed an approved course, submitted in a department-approved format within 5 business days of the conclusion of the last course (R 339.22154(7)). Course schedule and geographic location filed not less than 30 days before courses are held (R 339.22154(6)). Any change to the approval application reported within 30 days (R 339.22141(2)).
states.record_retention_period: Permanent. A real estate school must establish and permanently maintain a record for each student, containing the student's name and address, clock hours attended, grade where an examination determines successful completion, completion date, the last four digits of the Social Security number, date of birth, and licence identification number where applicable (R 339.22154(1)-(2)).
states.enrollment_period: Prelicensure education must be completed within the 36 months preceding the licence application (MCL 339.2504). Course approval itself expires one year after it is granted, with renewal filed not less than 60 days before expiry (R 339.22143).
states.final_exam_rules: Not prescribed by Michigan. R 339.22154(2)(c) records a grade only where an examination is required to determine successful completion, which leaves the examination to the school. StateCourse administers one as a provider standard.
states.proctoring_rules: Not prescribed. Michigan requires photo identification before the certificate of completion issues, and for distance learning requires the school to ensure the student whose attendance is reported is the student who completed the course (R 339.22154(5)). There is no supervised-examination requirement in MCL 339.2504 or R 339.22141 to R 339.22158.
states.certificate_rules: The certificate of completion must show the completion date, identification of the course including its name as approved by the department, the name AND approval number of the school, the student's name, and the number of clock hours completed (R 339.22141(1)(f)). It issues only after the student presents photo identification (R 339.22154(5)).
states.notes: 40 clock hours of approved prelicensure education in principles of real estate, including at least 4 clock hours of civil rights law and equal opportunity in housing, completed within the 36 months before application (MCL 339.2504). A student must attend 100 percent of the course, and distance-learning credit requires hours attended to equal hours approved (R 339.22152). Distance courses need prior approval and six elements: modules, a learning objective for each, a structured learning method, assessment during each module, and remediation repeating the module until the content is understood (R 339.22157(2)). ARELLO certification is accepted, and approval is suspended if it lapses; an equivalent delivery system may be approved instead (R 339.22157(3)-(4)). An asynchronous course must supply a student-signed attestation of clock hours, and the enrollment application must disclose the previous calendar year's completion percentage, refreshed by 1 February (R 339.22141(1)(h), (j)). Licensing examination administered by PSI. The rules were renumbered and largely rescinded effective 4 June 2025; the operative education rules are R 339.22141 to R 339.22158. Read on 2026-08-19.

states.reporting_requirements: Attendance records are submitted to the Commission within ten days after each course is delivered.
states.record_retention_period: Instructors and institutions delivering education must keep attendance records for each class for not less than five years, and must submit the attendance record to the Commission within ten days after each course is delivered.
states.notes: 54 classroom hours as Salesman Course I and Salesman Course II, against a curriculum the Commission establishes and publishes annually, completed within one year of the application date. The Commission's education-provider pages describe online and hybrid delivery, but the rules compilation reachable from this environment is a 2012 version that does not carry the 54-hour provision, so the hour figure and the delivery permission both need confirmation in the current rules before Wyoming is scheduled. Read on 2026-08-19.
